title: Hybrid Conference Event Management in Malaysia: How Light Up 7 Delivered MIA Conference 2026
description: Discover how Light Up 7 delivered MIA Conference 2026 through an integrated hybrid event management approach, combining creative development, live production, digital broadcasting and a dedicated virtual conference platform.

page_content.html_content:
Light Up 7 delivered MIA Conference 2026 through an integrated hybrid event management approach, combining creative development, live production, digital broadcasting and a dedicated virtual conference platform under one coordinated team. Working with the Malaysian Institute of Accountants, our scope included conference concept development, brochure and collateral design, multi-camera production, live feeds, Zoom streaming, virtual platform management, launch video production and launch gimmick execution. By managing the creative, technical and digital components together, we helped create a connected conference experience for physical and virtual delegates while maintaining a consistent event identity throughout.

The Challenge: Managing a Professional Hybrid Conference

A hybrid conference involves more than broadcasting the physical event online. The stage programme, speaker presentations, live feeds, virtual platform and delegate support must work together smoothly. For MIA Conference 2026, the solution needed to support up to 1000 virtual delegates across two conference days while maintaining secure access, reliable streaming and accurate attendance tracking. The project also required consistent event branding, recorded sessions, CPE progress tracking and real-time technical support.

Developing the Conference Concept and Collaterals

Light Up 7 developed the event concept and designed the supporting brochures and conference materials. Our conference collateral design helped communicate programme information clearly while maintaining a consistent professional identity across printed materials, presentation screens and the virtual platform. This gave both physical and virtual delegates a cohesive experience throughout the conference.

Live Production and Multi-Camera Coverage

Light Up 7 managed the technical production required to connect the venue with the virtual audience. Our multi-camera production captured speakers, presentations, panel discussions and important event moments from different angles. The production team switched between camera feeds in real time for the LED screens, live stream and session recordings.

The scope included:

  • Live Camera Switching
  • Speaker And Panel Coverage
  • LED Screen Feeds
  • Zoom Live Streaming
  • Presentation Integration
  • Technical Rehearsals
  • Session Recording

This created a more polished viewing experience than relying on a single fixed camera.

A Virtual Conference Platform for 1000 Delegates

A dedicated virtual conference platform was managed for up to 1000 delegates throughout the two-day conference. Each delegate received a unique login ID and platform link, with access limited to one active device at a time. Delegate information could also be imported before the conference and during last-minute registration periods.

The platform included:

  • Plenary And Concurrent Halls
  • My Agenda And Session Reminders
  • Help Desk And Troubleshooting Chat
  • Conference Evaluation Forms
  • On-Demand Sessions
  • Attendance And CPE Tracking
  • Announcements And Conference Notices

Delegates could bookmark preferred sessions, access conference materials and receive reminder emails before and during the event. All sessions were recorded in HD and made available for on-demand viewing. Selected sessions also included assessments for CPE credit hours, with progress automatically tracked within the platform.

Delegate Tracking and Technical Support

The platform recorded delegate login and logout times, active duration, feedback submissions and assessment completion. Attendance reports allowed the organiser to identify delegates who had not logged in and review each participant's total conference duration. Delegates could also download their own attendance records.

Throughout both conference days, Light Up 7 provided:

  • Platform Admission Management
  • Help Desk Team
  • Login And Access Support
  • Troubleshooting Chat
  • Hotline Assistance
  • Live Platform Monitoring
  • Delegate Reminder Emails

This support helped reduce disruption and allowed delegates to resolve technical issues quickly.

Launch Video and Launch Gimmick

Light Up 7 also produced the conference launch video and integrated it with a physical launch gimmick. The opening moment required coordination between video playback, LED screen visuals, lighting cues, VIP movements and stage management. By managing both the creative production and live execution, the launch became a seamless part of the conference experience.

The Outcome

MIA Conference 2026 brought its physical, virtual and creative components together through one coordinated production approach.

Light Up 7 helped deliver:

  • A Consistent Conference Identity
  • A Virtual Platform For 1000 Delegates
  • Multi-Camera Live Coverage
  • Zoom Streaming
  • Recorded And On-Demand Sessions
  • Attendance And CPE Tracking
  • Real-Time Delegate Support
  • An Integrated Launch Video And Gimmick

The project demonstrated how effective conference event management can connect physical and virtual audiences while maintaining a professional and consistent event experience.

Frequently Asked Questions

What Is Hybrid Event Management?

Hybrid event management combines physical event production with live streaming, virtual participation and digital platform management.

What Can a Virtual Conference Platform Include?

A virtual conference platform can include secure delegate access, live sessions, recordings, attendance tracking, assessments, feedback forms and technical support.

Can Light Up 7 Track Delegate Attendance?

Yes. The platform can track login times, active duration, feedback submissions and assessment completion.

Does Light Up 7 Provide Multi-Camera Production?

Yes. Light Up 7 provides multi-camera production for conferences, corporate events, launches and live broadcasts.
